svg.title: PicoClaw pull-request action and data flow
svg.desc: A clickable end-to-end map from a GitHub review assignment through an explicit user or configured-automation Track PR action, purpose and scope confirmation, AI review, finding decisions, implementation, scope resolution, validation, review comments, branch pushes, and deferred follow-up issues. Four exceptional gates are collected in an advanced rail. All fourteen numbered gates open their profile editor.

g.text: Pull request: from review request to safe outcomes
Follow the action and data path. Every numbered gate is clickable and opens its profile editor.
14 editable gates · click any numbered card

svg.text: After a review assignment, a user or configured workflow explicitly tracks the PR
AI reviews; the user decides what to publish, fix, defer, or dismiss
Only selected findings enter the implementation path
Deferred findings stay separate from the current PR
ADVANCED · ONLY WHEN THE MAIN PATH HITS AN EXCEPTION
#2 changed purpose/scope · #6 non-owner authorization before #7 · #13 rare reusable correction · #14 unknown review, branch, or issue result.

g.text: Any continued candidate is updated, then rechecked before validation
Checks fail or completion is revised → update candidate and repeat scope check
Explicit action after the GitHub request
goal · acceptance criteria · included / excluded work
Evaluate every changed area against purpose and scope
finding IDs · evidence · severity · changed areas
Choose how to resolve the candidate
Remove extra code · revise purpose/scope (#2) · defer follow-up · stop
If implementation continues, update the candidate and repeat the scope check.
No expansion of the current PR
One issue per approved deferred group
